answer.exemplar: Donnerstags wird klein geschrieben, weil Tagesnamen als Adverbien klein geschrieben werden.

questions.explanation: Day names become adverbs in lower case with -s. The tempting wrong idea is to keep the capital letter.
questions.hint: Lower case and -s mark the adverb.

questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: The comma before an infinitive clause
questions.learningObjective: Place a comma before an infinitive clause

stimulus.body: Mistake fix 52 is a short note. It contains an infinitive clause. The note must place the comma before the infinitive clause.

questions.stem: Which version places the comma correctly?

options.text: Er hofft, das Ziel zu erreichen.
Er hofft das Ziel, zu erreichen.
options.misconception: places the comma before zu instead of before the clause

options.text: Er hofft das Ziel zu erreichen.
Er hofft, das Ziel, zu erreichen.

questions.explanation: The comma stands before the infinitive clause. Option B misplaces it, C omits it, and D doubles it.
